description: A grand Parisian-style living room photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens in a centered symmetrical composition anchored by the fireplace. The room features full-height applied moulding paneling on all walls — arched niches, raised rectangular panels, and a deep dentil-profile cornice that runs around the entire perimeter — all painted in the same crisp off-white. A tall arched niche in the back left corner holds a white ceramic vase with sparse dried winter branches. The fireplace surround and fascia is dramatic black nero marquina marble with bold white veining, creating a strong focal point against the white walls. Above the fireplace, a large canvas artwork in cream and pale taupe with gestural abstract marks hangs in a thin natural wood frame. Tall French doors with multi-pane glazing and brass hardware flood the right side of the room with diffuse daylight. The seating group is entirely in warm cream and ivory — two curved linen sofas flank the arrangement, and two low rounded armchairs in ribbed cream fabric face the fireplace across a round white marble pedestal dining table. A small round marble side table and a small matte black circular side table flank the sofas at either end. The herringbone parquet hardwood floor in warm honey tones grounds the composition. The palette is a study in warm white monochrome with accents of black marble, honey wood, and brass. The mood is formal, quiet, and distinctly Parisian.
